title_as_printed: Apparent molar heat capacity of NaCl(aq)

footnotes_as_printed.a: One standard deviation in the apparent molar heat capacity divided by R.

pressure_note: flow calorimeter; p printed in each block label (6.85 to 36.17 MPa); pressure read to +/-0.01 MPa with a transducer calibrated to 0.1 MPa against a Heise gauge

T.note: listed T is the midpoint between the measured temperature rise DeltaT and DeltaT_max (text, eq 23)

value.what: apparent molar heat capacity of NaCl divided by R, from eq (22) Cp,phi = M cp,s + (cp,s - cp,w)/m with water cp from Haar et al. (cp,w printed in the block label)
value.scale_note: printed Cp,phi/R; the paper does not state R; its printed numbers reproduce eq. 22 with R = 8.314 J/(K mol) (pass 1 check)
value.unit_as_printed: dimensionless (Cp,phi divided by the gas constant R)

value2.what: specific heat capacity ratio of solution to water at T and p

value3.what: heat-loss-corrected power ratio, solution to water (volumetric heat capacity ratio; the measured quantity)

uncertainty.unit: dimensionless (one standard deviation of Cp,phi divided by R)
uncertainty.scale_note: printed Cp,phi/R; the paper does not state R; its printed numbers reproduce eq. 22 with R = 8.314 J/(K mol) (pass 1 check)

skip_rows.reason: T/p/DeltaT/cp,w block label rows (also carried by group_rows)

extra_unmapped: f (calibration correction factor applied to the power ratio, column 2)
DeltaT and cp,w of pure water (block labels)
conversion_needs: Cp,phi = printed Cp,phi/R x R; the value of R is not stated; the printed numbers reproduce eq (22) with R = 8.314 J/(K mol) (implied R 8.31 to 8.32 for all rows away from Cp,phi near 0)
notes: Two side-by-side column groups per block, stacked left group first, then right group. Blank lines inside a block (series of injections) are not printed labels and are not written. The 573.17 K block prints two 3.0072 mol/kg rows in the right group that nearly repeat the two left-group 3.0072 rows (0.8082/0.7302/-30.15 appears in both); printed, kept.
